name: albino_combat_SW_v01

request.prompt: Create a NEW dedicated MYTHIC-BOSS-quality hand-painted dark fantasy isometric RPG animation source for ALBINO DEMON, matching the supplied exact existing project reference. The name does NOT mean recolor white: preserve its vivid deep RED muscular skin, TWO enormous black ridged swept-back horns, one snarling fanged head, yellow eyes, TWO arms TWO digitigrade clawed legs, dark gunmetal SPIKED shoulder plates/forearm bracers/shin guards, skull-shaped belt buckle with hanging iron chains, short dark loincloth, long thick red tail curled close. No wings, shield or extra arms. Anatomical RIGHT hand grips ONE enormous iron crescent AXE on a long wood shaft; anatomical LEFT clawed hand is empty. Preserve boss-specific armor, skull belt, axe proportions, both horns and limb identity in all figures. Original detailed painted sprites, NOT a recolored existing rig, no lava or fist-golem shape. Orthographic elevated camera at 35 degrees. This sheet is SOUTHWEST front-left three-quarter: face/chest/toes aim diagonally LOWER LEFT. Front chest/skull belt visible. Anatomical RIGHT arm/axe remain same limb, not mirrored ownership. Contact blade projects LOWER LEFT. EXACTLY SEVEN complete separate connected character figures in a TWO-COLUMN FOUR-ROW grid: row1 has phase0 at left and phase1 at right; row2 phase2 left and phase3 right; row3 phase4 left and phase5 right; row4 phase6 left and right cell EMPTY. Reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: row0 IDLE neutral broad weighted stance, right axe head low-forward, left hand half-open; row1 IDLE inhale chest/shoulders lift subtly, head tilts and left fingers flex, planted soles; row2 ATTACK WINDUP deep knees/hips load, torso twists back and RIGHT elbow pulls axe back behind right shoulder, both feet braced; row3 ATTACK CONTACT right-handed horizontal cleave, blade unmistakably projects FORWARD in the stated facing direction ahead of head at enemy chest height, front foot planted with hips driving weight into strike, left EMPTY hand counterbalances; row4 ATTACK RECOVERY heavy axe follow-through dips forward, right elbow bends back and torso untwists, weight settles; row5 HIT RECOIL chest snaps back, head recoils and knees compress, right axe defensively across hip, left fingers spread; row6 HIT RECOVERY low braced stagger with different torso/leg pose, gaze forward, axe lowered. Specific articulated limb, hip, shoulder and axe movement rather than whole-body translation/rotation. Every axe shaft remains touching the RIGHT gripping hand. Entire horns, weapon, tail, claws and chains inside the CENTER FORTY PERCENT of each grid cell, enormous clean transparent gaps, figure small enough never to enter another row's axis-aligned bounding rectangle. Spacious square sprite sheet with a rigid 2-column by4-row layout; bottom-right grid cell fully EMPTY and transparent. Keep every full figure less than HALF the cell height and HALF cell width, leaving transparent outer border and broad gutters. ONE solid connected silhouette per figure, no detached floor/shadow/particles/glow/debris/specks. TRUE transparent alpha background, no text/grid/labels/platform.
